thread.text:
Today: Upper C had two loads to set. DB Bench Press worked up from 24kg (12 reps) to 26kg (12, 10) — all three sets landed in the 10-12 target, so 26kg is the number to carry forward. Chest Supported Row went 14kg×12 then 18kg×10, 10 — same story, 18kg is the working load. Lateral Raise held at 8kg×15, 15, 15, unchanged. Face Pull came in mixed: 15kg×12, 12, then 17.5kg×12 — only the last set was at the prescribed 17.5kg, so it doesn't cleanly test the progression rule. Hammer Curl hit 14kg×12, 12, 12, top of the 10-12 range on its first logged session at this load. Toes to Bar (bodyweight×8, 6) stood in for Hanging Leg Raise — a swap, not a regression; it's a harder movement, so lower reps track.

Trend: Lateral Raise has sat at 8kg×15, 15, 15 across 09-11, 09-14, 09-21 and now 09-26 — four sessions with no movement toward the 20-hold target that unlocks 9kg. Face Pull has also stalled at 12s since 09-17, still short of the 15-rep bar needed on two sessions running.

Right lat: 0/10 today, a clean green light. Upper C carries no iso-lateral row though, so it doesn't feed the row gate — that's Thursday's lift only. Thursday (09-24) logged 3/10 at 55kg on the right, also green; worth watching whether that load holds next Thursday.

Next session: Lower, Sun 27 Sep. Deadlift 60kg×5, 5, 5 — clean across all three earns 62.5kg. Squat holds at 70kg×8-10; knees complained at 80kg back on 09-12, so keep an eye on that rather than push through it.

Question: Face Pull moved between 15kg and 17.5kg within the same session where 17.5kg was prescribed throughout — plate mix-up, or did something ask for the lighter load partway through?
